name: agent-xray
description: Agent X-Ray — Find out why your AI agents fail. Powered by TypeSafe JEV.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
